description: Telnyx messaging, numbers, and voice endpoints, plus a synced message-history mirror, number setup audits, and spend rollups.

novel_features.name: Conversation view
novel_features.description: See the delivery timeline with one guest or vendor number: direction, status, parts and cost (Telnyx records carry no message bodies).

novel_features.name: Number audit
novel_features.description: Find owned numbers that cannot text: missing messaging profile or missing 10DLC campaign assignment.

novel_features.name: Spend rollup
novel_features.description: Total messaging cost by number, profile, direction, or day, with balance runway.

novel_features.name: Failure report
novel_features.description: Failed and undelivered texts grouped by error code and recipient.

novel_features.name: Unanswered threads
novel_features.description: Contacts whose latest text was inbound with no reply yet.

novel_features.name: Agent-safe send
novel_features.description: Send a text after checking the sender is wired correctly and showing recent history; requires --yes.
